newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales off 1.0 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales off 1.0 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales fell 1.0 percent in the week ended April 12 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 6.1 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was off 1.3 percent from the prior month.
"Sales were generally mixed relative to plan for most retailers," the report said. "A few retailers noted that adverse weather seemed to hurt sales during the week," it said.
The report, which is normally embargoed for 0900 EDT/1300 GMT, was again released early by other news agencies.
